Question: as salamu alaikum .my question is ,while in the qasar,should we offer the sunnat(if i have the time). dua ki guzarish. as salamu alaikum. Answer ID: 14283 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1065/1065=M/1430) Yes, if the time is allowing and there is no hurry, one should perform the sunnah salah: ویأتي المسافر بالسنن إن کان في حال أمن وقرار، وإلا لا یأتي بھا (الشامي ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
